name: Tulare County, CA
findings: Tulare County has 827 nonprofit organizations. 311 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 232 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tulare County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Tulare County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 89 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 89 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?
